actions.text: Received in the Senate. Read twice. Placed on Senate Legislative Calendar under General Orders. Calendar No. 624.
Motion to reconsider laid on the table Agreed to without objection.
On motion to suspend the rules and pass the bill Agreed to by the Yeas and Nays: (2/3 required): 343 - 79 (Roll no. 304). (text: CR H5679)
Passed/agreed to in House: On motion to suspend the rules and pass the bill Agreed to by the Yeas and Nays: (2/3 required): 343 - 79 (Roll no. 304).
Considered as unfinished business. (consideration: CR H5824)

At the conclusion of debate, the Yeas and Nays were demanded and ordered. Pursuant to the provisions of clause 8, rule XX, the Chair announced that further proceedings on the motion would be postponed.
DEBATE - The House proceeded with forty minutes of debate on H.R. 2140.
Considered under suspension of the rules. (consideration: CR H5679-5680)
Mr. Guthrie moved to suspend the rules and pass the bill.
Placed on the Union Calendar, Calendar No. 718.
Reported by the Committee on Energy and Commerce. H. Rept. 119-819.

dimensions.assessment: Affects entities applying for diesel emission grants, rebates, or loans, as well as populations exposed to diesel exhaust.
dimensions.evidence: reauthorizes through FY2029 a diesel emissions reduction program under which the Environmental Protection Agency provides grants, rebates, or loans

dimensions.assessment: Continues an existing program with minor administrative changes rather than creating a novel framework.
Extends authorization for an ongoing federal grant program through fiscal year 2029, though specific appropriation amounts are not detailed in the text.
dimensions.evidence: reauthorizes through FY2029 a diesel emissions reduction program

dimensions.assessment: Extends the expiration date of an already established statute by five years.
dimensions.evidence: Section 797(a) of the Energy Policy Act of 2005 (42 U.S.C. 16137(a)) is amended by striking '2024' and inserting '2029'.

dimensions.assessment: Extends the program duration nationally for a defined five-year period through fiscal year 2029.

missing_information: Specific funding authorization levels for the reauthorized fiscal years
importance_detail.rationale: This bill reauthorizes an existing EPA diesel emissions reduction grant and loan program through 2029, continuing federal funding for engine replacements and retrofits.
